summary: The selected Bedford descriptions contain overlapping unit claims and an unresolved temporary-use lead. They do not establish how many homes became legally available for occupancy.

findings.interpretation: The parent application describes the phase-wide plan, not 70 verified completed homes.
findings.reviewQuestion: Which of the eight buildings have separate occupancy evidence?

findings.interpretation: The A3 building permit describes nine apartments within one named building.
findings.reviewQuestion: Is A3 part of the parent total, and what document establishes its usable date?

findings.quote: IN RELATION TO WORK PERFORMED UNDER BP-2024-13992
findings.interpretation: The sprinkler description explicitly names A3's building permit and repeats its nine apartments. This is a relationship proposal, not another nine homes.
findings.reviewQuestion: Does a reviewer confirm the explicit link and its building identity?

findings.quote: PENDING COMPLETING OF PERMIT BP-2024-13992, TEMPORARY USE OF 3 STORY APARTMENT BUILDING
findings.interpretation: A temporary-use application points back to A3 while describing work under its building permit as pending.
findings.reviewQuestion: What original authorization, conditions and effective date, if any, apply to A3?

findings.interpretation: A4 is separately labeled from A3 despite sharing the development parcel.
findings.reviewQuestion: Can separate original documents establish the status of A4 without merging it into A3?

limits: This is a saved model analysis of five descriptions from the selected public snapshot. A human selected and edited the displayed findings for clarity, and each quoted passage is checked against its source when replayed. The analysis is not a live model run or an approval.
